meta.name: runbook
meta.description: Write an operating runbook from the delivered system and verified procedures. Use when the customer team or a successor needs to operate without the original engineer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已交付的系统整理成别人能照着独立运维的操作手册
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果系统要交给客户或接替者独立运维,却没人记下操作步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a delivered system into an operating manual others can follow on their own
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're handing a system to a team or successor who must run it without you

howto.what: 根据已交付的系统和已验证的流程，写一份运维 runbook，让接手的人能照着操作。产出会把实现、验证、部署、验收分开记录，并保留未知项。
howto.when: 当客户团队或继任者要在原工程师不在的情况下自行运维时触发。若由 @fde 调用，则沿用其已脱敏的 packet 与范围，不重做设置或重问已答过的问题。

say.text: 根据已交付的系统和已验证的步骤，写一份运维 runbook。
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约与方法文档。

say.text: 接手的人要自己运维了，帮我整理操作手册。
say.note: 未知项会保留，不会补编。

say.text: 把实现、验证、部署、验收分开写进 runbook。
say.note: 各阶段记录分开，不混在一起。

howto.what_en: It writes an operating runbook from the delivered system and verified procedures, so a successor can operate without the original engineer. It keeps implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance separate and preserves unknowns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the customer team or a successor must operate without the original engineer. If invoked by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or repeated questions.

say_en.text: Write an operating runbook from the delivered system and verified steps.
say_en.note: Reads the task context contract and method first.

say_en.text: The new team runs it now, so draft the operating manual.
Keep implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance separate.
say_en.note: Each stage is recorded on its own.
